paper_title: VISH$ν$: a unified solution to five SM shortcomings with a protected electroweak scale
suggested_experiment_name: VISHnu inflation predictions (Planck 2018 / BICEP-Keck 2021 CMB constraints)
coupling_convention: y values are the tensor-to-scalar ratio r (dimensionless, as plotted); x values are the non-minimal coupling xi_S (dimensionless, as plotted). NOT a mass/coupling exclusion plane.
notes: This is a theoretical model-building paper (VISHnu, an NDW=1 variant of the nuDFSZ axion model) focused on inflationary dynamics and naturalness. It PREDICTS a viable axion mass window of [40 ueV, ~2 meV] (equivalently a range of f_A) for the post-inflationary PQ-restored scenario, but does not present any new experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection with extractable coupling-vs-mass data. The mass window is a theory target for existing/future haloscopes (ADMX, MADMAX, CAPP, HAYSTAC, ALPHA, ORGAN, IAXO), not an exclusion limit itself.
